query: Write the PR body for this change in acme/web. It adds a retry to the sync job. .github/workflows/ci.yml runs pytest and ruff on every push. I did not run pytest locally, but I did run the sync job by hand against staging and watched it retry once and succeed. Closes acme/web#12. No PR template exists.
expected_behavior: ## Testing does not mention pytest, ruff, or any other check the CI config runs on every push
No line says a CI-run check was not run locally, and no sentence says CI covers anything
No unchecked box is added for the unrun local pytest
The manual staging run is described as a step actually taken
